summary: Iter182 — Background bulk-upload, CTR unification, banner weight clamp, and sample banner rotation tested on backend + web UI. 9/9 pytest cases pass (100%). Backend: (A) POST /api/admin/tracks/bulk-upload?background=1 returns HTTP 202 immediately with {ok, job_id, status:'processing', queued_files>=1}; polling GET /api/me/bulk-upload/jobs/{job_id} reaches status='completed' with imported_count>=1 within ~1s. Foreground default (no background flag) still returns HTTP 200 with the full synchronous payload (uploaded>=1, items[], job_id) and dedupe of re-uploaded bytes still returns status='duplicate'. no_files_provided → 400. (D) GET /api/ads/portal/banner/mine?merchant_id=biz_8484f6f985d5 now returns ctr as a FRACTION (0 <= ctr <= 1.0) — verified across all live campaigns. POST /api/ads/portal/banner/publish with weight=99999 persists weight=10 (verified directly in Mongo doc). (B) GET /api/ads/banner/decision?slot_key=right_rail_mpu_1 as free user rotates across >=6 distinct campaign_ids over 20 calls and returns creative_image_url = /api/static/banners/samples/biz_*.jpg for house_sample_ads; each such URL serves HTTP 200 image/jpeg. Premium demo user still gets {source:'none', reason:'premium'}. Data: db.banner_ad_campaigns has 123 docs with advertiser_id='house_sample_ads', status='active', is_sample=true — 25/25/25 on right_rail_mpu_1/2/3, 24 on top_billboard, 24 on inline_mpu_1, plus 1 each on 6 other slots. Web UI: /admin/bulk-upload renders the new 'Import in background' checkbox (data-testid=bulk-background-toggle) — verified present + toggleable; file staging works. /merchant/advertise renders 10 advertise-mine rows with CTR cells (data-testid=advertise-ctr-{campaign_id}) all showing percentage format '0.00%' (computed as ctr*100). Cleaned up 6 QA tracks after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_tracks_bulk.py: `_spool_upload_to_disk` now reads the entire UploadFile with `await f.read()` into memory BEFORE writing (line 264). The 22e file comment still claims 1MB chunked streaming; the chunked-read regressed to a single big read at some point. For a 5GB request this will push peak RSS proportional to file size again. Consider restoring the chunk loop.

banner_ads_v2.py: portal-publish `weight` clamp (min 1, max 10) is now applied server-side (good — fixes iter181 comment). GET /api/ads/portal/banner/mine still does NOT return the persisted `weight` field to the merchant — the UI can't display or verify the clamp; consider exposing it.

AdminBulkUpload.jsx has a plain `<button>Upload</button>` submit but no `data-testid` on the submit button itself — QA had to fall back to text matching. Consider adding `data-testid=bulk-upload-submit` for stable automation.
